q: The Neimark-Sacker bifurcation (discrete-time Hopf bifurcation) occurs when a fixed point of a map f: ℝ² → ℝ² has eigenvalues e^{±iθ} crossing the unit circle. The bifurcation produces:
opts: An invariant closed curve (invariant circle) surrounding the fixed point
A fixed point with different stability
exp: Neimark-Sacker bifurcation: when the multipliers e^{±iθ} cross the unit circle (|multiplier| passes through 1 as complex conjugate pair), an invariant closed curve is born (discrete-time analogue of the limit cycle in Hopf). For irrational θ/2π, the dynamics on the invariant curve is quasi-periodic.
